title: A Study Group Faces a Temptation to Cheat
script: Doni: [thoughtful] Wulan, look what I found. Someone posted photos of tomorrow's exam questions in our class group chat.
Wulan: Wait, seriously? Where did those even come from?
Doni: [gently] Apparently someone in the earlier class session photographed the paper and shared it before anyone noticed.
Wulan: Doni, I'm not sure we should even be looking at this, honestly.
Doni: [carefully] Everyone in the group chat has already seen it. We would just be at a disadvantage if we didn't look too.
Wulan: That logic feels backward to me. Because others did something wrong doesn't mean it becomes okay for us.
Doni: [reflective] This exam decides half our final grade, Wulan. You know how much I've struggled with this subject all semester.
Wulan: I know you've struggled, and I've watched you study late almost every night. That effort deserves an honest result, not a stolen one.
Doni: [honestly] But what if I fail anyway, even after using these? At least this way I'd have a real chance.
Wulan: Would it really feel like your success though, if you knew the truth about how you got there?
Doni: [warmly] No, honestly, it probably wouldn't. I think I already knew that before I even showed you the photos.
Wulan: Let’s report the leak privately now, avoid forwarding it, and study from our real notes. The school may need to replace the exam.
Doni: [sincere] Part of me is still scared it won't be enough, though.
Wulan: Maybe it won't be, and that's frightening, but I'd rather fail honestly than pass while feeling like a fraud every time I remember it.
Doni: Okay. I will save only the minimum evidence for a private report, then delete the images. We should not accuse classmates publicly.
Wulan: I will contact the instructor through the official channel. Now pass me your chapter-six notes; I still need to understand them.
Doni: Deal. We will act honestly and help the school make the assessment fair.

quiz.question: What did Doni find in the class group chat?
quiz.explanation: Doni found photos of tomorrow's exam questions posted in the class group chat.

quiz.question: What is Doni's first argument for looking at the photos?
options: Everyone else has already seen it, so they would be at a disadvantage otherwise
quiz.explanation: Doni argues that everyone has already seen it, so they would be at a disadvantage if they didn't look too.

quiz.question: How does Wulan respond to that argument?
options: She says others doing something wrong doesn't make it okay for them
She says the exam doesn't matter
She reports Doni to the teacher
quiz.explanation: Wulan says that logic feels backward, because others doing something wrong doesn't make it okay for them too.

quiz.question: What does Doni admit when Wulan asks if it would feel like real success?
options: No, it probably wouldn't feel like his own success
He would tell everyone about it
quiz.explanation: Doni admits it probably wouldn't feel like real success, and that he already suspected that before showing Wulan.

quiz.question: What do Wulan and Doni decide to do at the end?
options: Delete the photos and study together honestly
quiz.explanation: They agree to delete the photos and study together using their actual notes instead.

quiz.question: Why is deleting the photos alone not enough?
options: The leak can still make the exam unfair for the whole class
Their notes contain the same questions
quiz.explanation: The institution needs to know before using the compromised exam.

quiz.question: What should they send the instructor?
options: The leaked images in another group
A list of students to punish publicly
A private report with enough evidence to investigate

quiz.question: What does Wulan challenge in Doni’s argument?
options: Other people’s cheating does not make cheating acceptable

quiz.question: How should the school respond fairly?
options: Ignore the leak after one deletion
Investigate and replace or adjust the compromised assessment
quiz.explanation: A system-level response protects honest students.

quiz.question: What does Doni finally choose?
options: Wait until after the exam to speak
Report the leak, delete it, and study from legitimate notes
quiz.explanation: His choice combines integrity with corrective action.
